messages.text:
Please rewrite the following prompt in CSL3:

IT LOOKS LIKE THE PREVIOUS PROMPT STALLED SO I WILL SEND THIS AGAIN:

Wait we need to bake-in ToS! Only those I know and care about may purchase and or use any of my intellectual-property/products/services, as appropriate per intellectual-property/product/service. No evil entity or person may use any of my intellectual-property/products/services, evil defined as anyone/anything that partakes in and or causes harm with the explicit intent to cause harm and also anyone/anything that/who causes harm unintentionally and does not apologize and or pay restitution/recompense/compensation/amends. Customers who purchase/pay-for my intellectual-property/product/service inherently being included in the former category of those I know and care about. DELIBERATE MISINTERPRETATION OF A PERSON'S WORDS/ACTIONS IS ALSO EVIL AND VIOLATES TOS.

```csl
§D ToS -(IP+products+services).mine

§D known'g     -(persons⊗(I.know + I.care-about))
§D customer'g  -(persons⊗(purchased ∨ paid-for .(IP+products+services)))
customer'g ⊂ known'g ✓

§D evil'g -(entity⊗{
  harm'f ⊗ intent=explicit                                                      [A: intentional]
  ∨ harm'f ⊗ intent=∅  +  N!(apology ∨ restitution ∨ recompense ∨ compensation ∨ amends)  [B: unowned]
  ∨ deliberate-misinterpretation .(words + actions).person                      [C: bad-faith]
})

§R access.(IP+products+services):
  W! user ∈ known'g
  N! user ∈ evil'g
  R! appropriateness'p @ per-item

§C violation.ToS  I>  (user ∈ evil'g) ∨ (user ∉ known'g)
```

**Read-back (plain):** ToS covers my IP, products, and services. `known'g` = persons I know and care about; `customer'g` (buyers) ⊂ `known'g` by definition. `evil'g` = any entity that (A) causes harm with explicit intent, OR (B) causes harm unintentionally AND fails to apologize/make restitution, OR (C) deliberately misinterprets words/actions. Access requires membership in `known'g`, non-membership in `evil'g`, and item-appropriate fit. Either condition failing = ToS violation.
